例句

  1. I was very happy when I saw my mother going to work wearing the earrings I had bought her.
    我看到媽媽戴著我買給她的耳環去上班，覺得非常開心。
  2. I saw Tom waiting for the bus.
    我看到 Tom 在等公車。
  3. We heard a baby crying next door.
    我們聽到隔壁有嬰兒在哭。
  4. The kids watched the fish swimming in the pond.
    孩子們看著魚在池塘裡游。
  5. Did you see Ann talking with the new teacher?
    你有看到 Ann 在跟新老師講話嗎？
  6. We watched the monkeys eating bananas.
    我們看著猴子吃香蕉。
  7. I heard someone singing in the bathroom.
    我聽到有人在浴室裡唱歌。
  8. She saw her son running toward her.
    她看到她兒子朝她跑過來。
  9. This is the cake my grandmother made.
    這是我奶奶做的蛋糕。
  10. The boy you saw at the station is my brother.
    你在車站看到的那個男生是我弟弟。
  11. The ramen which we ate in Sapporo was delicious.
    我們在札幌吃的拉麵很好吃。
  12. Is this the bag you lost?
    這是你弄丟的包包嗎？
  13. The movie that we saw last night was boring.
    我們昨晚看的電影很無聊。
  14. I still remember the song my grandmother sang to me.
    我還記得我奶奶唱給我聽的那首歌。
  15. The teacher we like most is Mr. Wang.
    我們最喜歡的老師是王老師。
  16. My father bought me a new bike.
    我爸爸買了一台新腳踏車給我。
  17. I bought some flowers for my mother.
    我買了一些花給我媽媽。
  18. Ann bought her brother a birthday cake.
    Ann 買了一個生日蛋糕給她弟弟。
  19. Can you buy me a drink at the convenience store?
    你可以在便利商店買一瓶飲料給我嗎？
  20. In Japan, my uncle bought a doll for my little sister.
    我叔叔在日本買了一個娃娃給我妹妹。
  21. We bought our teacher a card for Teachers' Day.
    我們在教師節買了一張卡片送給老師。
  22. I saw my father wearing the tie I had bought him.
    我看到我爸爸打著我買給他的領帶。
  23. I bought a souvenir for each of my friends.
    我買了一個紀念品給每一個朋友。
  24. My grandmother loves the scarf that I bought for her.
    我奶奶很喜歡我買給她的圍巾。
  25. I heard my parents talking about the trip.
    我聽到我爸媽在討論那趟旅行。
  26. The shoes my mother had bought me were too big.
    我媽媽買給我的鞋子太大了。
  27. When I got home, I saw my dog sleeping on my bed.
    我回到家的時候，看到我的狗在我床上睡覺。
  28. Tom bought his girlfriend a ring.
    Tom 買了一枚戒指給他女朋友。
  29. The hotel which we stayed at was near the station.
    我們住的那家旅館在車站附近。
  30. I was surprised when I saw my teacher shopping at the supermarket.
    我看到老師在超市買東西，嚇了一跳。
  31. My sister went to the party wearing her new jacket.
    我妹妹穿著她的新外套去參加派對。
  32. He lay on the bed listening to music.
    他躺在床上聽音樂。
  33. We walked in the park holding hands.
    我們手牽手在公園裡散步。
